rater: one rater, an AI, looking at 8 m aerial photo crops; this is not an expert survey
method: Each label was written from the photo crop (as is, shadows lifted, raw 8 m pixels, and a wider 810 m crop for context) before the estimator numbers or the slope panel were looked at. Rules are in README.md and CRITERIA.labelRules of the harness. confidence: high = clear, low = I lean one way but could be wrong.
